title: Vivid Community Catalog
description: Defines community/extension engines and models that appear in Vivid's UI. The `label` fields are the exact display names shown in the algorithm picker, queue card, and model selector — choose them carefully.

operation.description: Which processing category this engine belongs to.

engine.description: Unique engine identifier. Use 'community:<slug>' for community engines.

label.description: Human-readable engine name shown in the algorithm picker and queue card. Example: 'MyArch - Super Resolution'. This is the primary display name — it appears as-is in the UI.

description.description: Short description shown as tooltip/subtitle in the algorithm picker.

backends.description: Allowed backend IDs. If omitted, all backends the host supports are available.

models.description: Available model variants for this engine.

defaultModel.description: Model value to select by default when user switches to this engine.

value.description: Model identifier passed to the inference backend. For ONNX models this is the filename; for built-in models it's a short ID like 'myarch-v1'.

label.description: Human-readable model name shown in the model dropdown and queue card. Keep it short — the engine name is already displayed separately, so don't repeat it here. Example: 'V1 Compact' instead of 'MyArch V1 Compact'.

recommended.description: If true, this model is highlighted as the recommended choice.

supportedScales.description: Scale factors this model supports (e.g. ['2x', '4x']). Only relevant for upscaling models.
